text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Contact sheet 21.0 to 21.8s. The stranded white car holds in floodwater with only the hazard lamps blinking. Caption ends by 21.4s and the frame is captionless to 21.8s. Roughly 2.4s of this scene since 19.8 is a held close view with only lamp flicker.
